sources.observed_match_data: FotMob final scores, expected goals, team stats, and declared lineups

evidence_findings: The frozen XI averaged 9.05/11 starters; selection error still reaches Player Alpha before kickoff.
Observed match xG totals spanned 1.77-6.39, while the base forecast spanned only 2.62-3.33; the goal environment is over-compressed in this sample.
Only 3/5 route families became preferred; missing direct_transition, wide_delivery.
The best side-xG MAE among coefficient choices frozen before kickoff is applied_conservative; this result does not fit a new coefficient or authorize a change.
audit_read.next_iteration: Audit the route and lineup assumptions behind structural misses; do not refit the context coefficient on this partial sample.
